results.content: 68:The monthly statement shows all receipts and expenditures of the Government, including those made from cash accounts held outside the United States Treasury. These reports cover transactions recorded in the accounts of the agencies during the reporting period. The net of the transactions as compiled from these reports is reconciled in the monthly statement to changes in the balance in the Treasurer's account and in cash held outside the Treasurer's account and changes in the public debt outstanding.

cpi_1961 = [29.8, 29.8, 29.8, 29.8, 29.8, 29.8, 30.0, 29.9, 30.0, 30.0, 30.0, 30.0]

print(f"CPI-U Annual Average 1961: {avg_1961:.1f}")
print(f"CPI-U Annual Average 1962: {avg_1962:.1f}")

# Adjust FY1960 and FY1961 debt to constant 1962 dollars
# Formula: adjusted = nominal * (CPI_1962 / CPI_year)
debt_1960_adj = debt_1960 * (avg_1962 / avg_1960)

print(f"\nDebt FY1960 nominal: {debt_1960}")
print(f"Debt FY1961 nominal: {debt_1961}")

print(f"\nDebt FY1960 in 1962$: {debt_1960_adj}")
print(f"Debt FY1961 in 1962$: {debt_1961_adj}")

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(debt_1961_adj - debt_1960_adj)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference (1961 adj - 1960 adj): {diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {diff:.3f}")

Get BLS CPI-U annual average index for 1960, 1961, 1962

steps.message: (tool use)

arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, getcontext
getcontext().prec = 50

# Public debt outstanding at end of fiscal year (millions of dollars)
# From Treasury Bulletin table (line 221-223 of treasury_bulletin_1962_08.txt)
# FY ends June 30 pre-1976
debt_1960 = Decimal('286331')  # End FY1960
debt_1961 = Decimal('288971')  # End FY1961
debt_1962 = Decimal('298201')  # End FY1962

# BLS CPI-U Annual Average (1982-84=100, not seasonally adjusted)
# Official published values from BLS API
cpi_1960 = Decimal('29.6')
cpi_1961 = Decimal('29.9')
cpi_1962 = Decimal('30.2')

# Adjust to constant 1962 dollars
# adjusted = nominal * (CPI_1962 / CPI_year)
debt_1960_adj = debt_1960 * cpi_1962 / cpi_1960
debt_1961_adj = debt_1961 * cpi_1962 / cpi_1961

print(f"FY1960 debt adjusted to 1962$: {debt_1960_adj}")
print(f"FY1961 debt adjusted to 1962$: {debt_1961_adj}")

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(debt_1961_adj - debt_1960_adj)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {diff.quantize(Decimal('0.001'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)}")

# Also show which is larger
print(f"\n1960 adj ({debt_1960_adj}) vs 1961 adj ({debt_1961_adj})")
print(f"1960 adj > 1961 adj: {debt_1960_adj > debt_1961_adj}")
EOF

# FY1960 debt: 286,331 million, CPI 1960: 29.6, CPI 1962: 30.2
# FY1961 debt: 288,971 million, CPI 1961: 29.9, CPI 1962: 30.2

# Adjusted FY1960 = 286331 * (30.2 / 29.6)
adj_1960 = 286331 * (30.2 / 29.6)
# Adjusted FY1961 = 288971 * (30.2 / 29.9)
adj_1961 = 288971 * (30.2 / 29.9)

print(f"Adjusted FY1960: {adj_1960}")
print(f"Adjusted FY1961: {adj_1961}")
print(f"Difference: {abs(adj_1961 - adj_1960):.3f}")

# Check: the inflation factor for 1960 is larger (30.2/29.6 ≈ 1.02027)
# and for 1961 is smaller (30.2/29.9 ≈ 1.01003)
# So even though nominal 1961 debt > nominal 1960 debt,
# after adjustment 1960 debt grows more due to larger inflation factor
# Result: adjusted 1960 > adjusted 1961, which makes sense

print(f"\nInflation factor 1960: {30.2/29.6}")
print(f"Inflation factor 1961: {30.2/29.9}")
EOF
